articles.title: Florida Adds 72 Local Dengue Cases in One Week as Pinellas Nearly Doubles and 2026 Total Hits 368
articles.description: Florida reported 72 new local dengue cases in one week, bringing its 2026 total to 368. Pinellas nearly doubled, and September onsets now lead the season.
